decisions.reason: We would keep the passenger check-in mobile app because it fits our announced innovation path in airport services, was publicly presented, and weak traction can still be attributed to the temporary shock to air travel rather than to a failed concept.

We would keep the passenger processing technology because the firm made a visible public launch commitment to PassBoard, it is close to our core integrated security offer, and disappointing results can plausibly be seen as temporary given the disruption in aviation.

We would keep the self-service airline check-in solution because it supports our high-end, efficiency-and-customer-experience positioning and the poor market environment since launch gives management a strong justification to persist rather than withdraw.
